jobs=()

while IFS= read -r id || test -n "$id"; do
  if printf '%s\n' "$id" | grep -Eq -- '^[a-z][a-z0-9]{0,5}$'; then :; else printf 'Invalid jobs\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
  case "$seen" in *"|$id|"*) printf 'Invalid jobs\n' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

  jobs=( "${jobs[@]}" "$id" )

done < jobs.txt
completed='|'
while IFS= read -r id || test -n "$id"; do
  case "$seen" in *"|$id|"*) : ;; *) printf 'Invalid checkpoint\n' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
  case "$completed" in *"|$id|"*) printf 'Invalid checkpoint\n' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
  completed=$completed$id'|'
done < checkpoint.txt
pending=()
already=0
ledger=''
plan=''
for id in "${jobs[@]}"; do
  case "$completed" in
    *"|$id|"*)
      if test -f "$id.done"; then :; else printf 'Checkpoint mismatch: %s\n' "$id" >&2; exit 2; fi
      actual=$(cat "$id.done"; printf '.')
      expected='Completed: '$id'
.'
      if test "$actual" = "$expected"; then :; else printf 'Checkpoint mismatch: %s\n' "$id" >&2; exit 2; fi
      plan=$plan'Already: '$id'

      already=$((already+1))
      ;;
    *)

      pending=( "${pending[@]}" "$id" )
      plan=$plan'Pending: '$id'

  esac
  ledger=$ledger$id'
'
done
if test "$mode" = apply; then
  for id in "${pending[@]}"; do printf 'Completed: %s\n' "$id" > "$id.done"; done
  printf '%s' "$ledger" > checkpoint.txt
fi
printf '%sAlready count: %s\nPending count: %s\n' "$plan" "$already" "${#pending[@]}"
exit 0
